topicName: Gợi ý, lời đề nghị và lời mời

rules.rule: 1. Đưa ra gợi ý (Suggestions) & Phản hồi:
rules.formula: Why don't we + V-inf? / Let's + V-inf / How about / What about + V-ing? / Shall we + V-inf?
rules.examples: Đồng ý: 'That's a great idea!' / 'Sounds good to me!' / 'That sounds like fun!'. Từ chối: 'I'd love to, but I have to study.'

rules.rule: 2. Đưa ra lời đề nghị giúp đỡ (Offers) & Phản hồi:
rules.formula: Can/May I help you? / Shall I + V-inf? / Would you like me to + V-inf?
rules.examples: Đồng ý: 'Yes, please. That's very kind of you.' Từ chối: 'No, thank you. I can manage it myself.'

rules.rule: 3. Đưa ra lời mời (Invitations) & Phản hồi:
rules.formula: Would you like to + V-inf? / Do you want to join us for...?
rules.examples: Đồng ý: 'Yes, I'd love to. Thank you!' / 'Sure, why not?'. Từ chối: 'I'd love to, but I'm afraid I have an appointment.'
